warnings: 9 divergent transitions: the sampler could not explore part of the posterior, so estimates may be biased.

identifiability_notes: Channel contributions are only partially identified. Channels whose spend moves together, or whose adstock and saturation shapes are similar, trade off against one another: the model can fit the data well while assigning credit between them differently from the truth.
Credible intervals on channel contribution are wide (widest: paid_search_spend, 49,778 to 294,919). Point estimates of contribution should never be quoted without them.
Recovering a parameter from simulated data shows the estimator works on this process. It is not evidence of causal media effectiveness, which observational marketing data cannot establish on its own.
